caption: The drawing depicts a single full-length dress rendered in shades of black, grey, and dark tones, set against a plain, light beige background. The dress has long, voluminous sleeves that narrow at the cuffs, a fitted bodice, and a high, rounded neckline adorned with a pattern of large, rounded loops or petal-like shapes. There are narrow, vertical panels or seams running from the shoulders down to the waist, and the skirt flares gently from the waist to the hem. Near the lower part of the skirt, there is a decorative wavy trim that runs horizontally around the dress. The illustration is detailed with visible shading to indicate the folds and texture of the fabric. There are no other objects or additional elements present in the drawing, except for a small signature in the bottom right corner.
